tasks.title: Create a thumbnail with motion blur
tasks.quote: First thing: create a thumbnail with motion blur so it reads as action.

tasks.title: Put my face on the left third of thumbnails
tasks.quote: You should always put your face on the left third of the frame.

tasks.title: Export videos at 4K
tasks.quote: Make sure you export at 4K even if your audience watches on phones.

tasks.title: Redo the video intro under ten seconds
tasks.quote: What I'd do is redo the whole intro and cut it to under ten seconds.

tasks.title: Add captions to videos
tasks.quote: Don't forget to add captions, they boost retention a lot.

tasks.title: Batch record three videos
tasks.quote: You want to batch record three videos every Sunday.
